summary: The open AI model ecosystem spans massive model repositories and developer-facing inference platforms. Hugging Face dominates as the central hub, crossing 3 million public models in August 2026, though download distribution is extremely skewed — roughly half of all models have fewer than 200 downloads while the top 200 models account for nearly 50% of all downloads. Alongside this repository, a growing class of serverless inference providers (Together AI, Fireworks AI, SiliconFlow, Replicate) and local-first runtimes (Ollama) compete to serve open-weight models like Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, and Mistral at low cost, with China-based model families increasingly surpassing U.S. ones in monthly downloads.

platforms.name: Hugging Face
platforms.purpose: The central open repository and community hub for AI models, datasets, and demos (Spaces), plus a serverless Inference API and partner inference providers.
platforms.model_count: ~3 million+ public models (surpassed 3M in August 2026, adding ~747,000 in the first 7.7 months of 2026)
platforms.pricing: Free hosting for public repos; Pro ~$9/mo; Enterprise org plans; Inference API and Inference Endpoints billed by compute/usage; pay-as-you-go routing to partner inference providers
features: Largest model and dataset registry with Git-based versioning
Serverless Inference API and dedicated Inference Endpoints
Routing to third-party inference providers (Together, Fireworks, SambaNova, etc.)
Download/usage stats, model cards, and safetensors security scanning
platforms.best_for: Researchers, ML engineers, and anyone needing the broadest selection of open models/datasets or wanting to publish and share models

platforms.name: Ollama
platforms.purpose: Local-first runtime for downloading and running open LLMs on your own machine (macOS, Windows, Linux) with a simple CLI and local API.
platforms.model_count: Curated library of ~200+ models and many quantized variants (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Gemma, Mistral, Phi, etc.), plus GGUF imports from Hugging Face
platforms.pricing: Free and open source; no usage fees since inference runs locally (optional Ollama Cloud/Turbo for hosted models)
features: Modelfile for custom model configuration and system prompts
Integrations with popular UIs and dev tools
platforms.best_for: Developers and privacy-conscious users who want to run open models locally for free, prototyping, and offline use

platforms.name: Replicate
platforms.purpose: Cloud platform to run and deploy open-source models via API without managing infrastructure, including image, video, audio, and language models.
platforms.model_count: Thousands of community and official models (Cog-packaged), spanning LLMs, diffusion/image, video, and audio
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-use billed by compute time (per-second GPU/CPU) or per-request/per-output for some models; no subscription required
features: Run any model via a simple HTTP API
Cog framework for packaging and deploying custom models
Strong catalog of image/video generation models (SDXL, Flux, etc.)
platforms.best_for: App developers who want to ship AI features (especially generative media) quickly via API without MLOps overhead

platforms.name: Together AI
platforms.purpose: High-performance serverless inference and fine-tuning platform for open-weight LLMs and multimodal models, plus dedicated GPU clusters.
platforms.model_count: 200+ open models (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mixtral, FLUX, embeddings, etc.)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token for serverless inference (per million input/output tokens), with per-hour pricing for dedicated endpoints and GPU clusters
features: OpenAI-compatible API for fast serverless inference
Fine-tuning (LoRA and full) with hosting of custom models
Dedicated endpoints and GPU cluster rental for training
Broad support for latest open-weight releases
platforms.best_for: Startups and developers building production LLM apps on open models who need low-cost, scalable inference and fine-tuning

platforms.name: Fireworks AI
platforms.purpose: Speed-optimized serverless inference platform for open and fine-tuned LLMs, vision, and audio models aimed at low-latency production workloads.
platforms.model_count: 100+ curated open models plus custom/fine-tuned model hosting
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token serverless pricing; on-demand GPU deployments billed per GPU-hour; enterprise plans available
platforms.best_for: Developers and enterprises needing fast, reliable, production-grade inference on open models with strong tooling

platforms.name: SiliconFlow
platforms.purpose: Developer inference cloud offering low-cost serverless access to a wide range of open models, with strong coverage of Chinese open-weight families.
platforms.model_count: 100+ open models including Qwen, DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, Llama, FLUX, and embeddings
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token/usage pricing that is typically very competitive; free tier/credits for some models
features: Strong support for leading Chinese open models (Qwen, DeepSeek, GLM)
LLM, image generation, and embedding/reranking endpoints
platforms.best_for: Developers wanting affordable access to top Chinese and global open models, especially in Asia-Pacific markets

platforms.name: Groq
platforms.purpose: Ultra-low-latency inference platform powered by custom LPU hardware, serving open-weight LLMs at very high token-generation speeds.
platforms.model_count: Dozens of curated open models (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mixtral, Whisper, etc.)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token serverless pricing; free developer tier with rate limits; enterprise plans
features: Industry-leading tokens-per-second throughput via LPU hardware
Low and consistent latency for real-time apps
platforms.best_for: Developers building real-time, latency-sensitive applications (chat, agents, voice) on open models

platforms.name: OpenRouter
platforms.purpose: Unified API aggregator and router that gives access to hundreds of open and proprietary models across many inference providers through a single endpoint.
platforms.model_count: 400+ models (open and closed) from dozens of underlying providers
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token with pass-through provider pricing plus a small markup/credit system; no subscription
features: Single OpenAI-compatible API for many providers/models
Automatic routing, failover, and price/latency optimization
Access to both open-weight and frontier closed models
platforms.best_for: Developers who want flexible access and automatic failover across many models/providers without multiple accounts

platforms.name: Modal
platforms.purpose: Serverless cloud for running custom AI/ML workloads and model inference in Python with on-demand GPUs, used to deploy open models at scale.
platforms.model_count: Any open model you deploy (not a fixed catalog); supports Hugging Face, vLLM, and custom containers
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-second compute billing for CPU/GPU usage; free starter credits
features: Fast cold starts and autoscaling to zero
Batch jobs, fine-tuning, and scheduled workloads
platforms.best_for: Engineering teams that want to self-deploy and scale custom open-model inference or training without managing infrastructure
